judge.rationale: The candidate appear to have stopped partway through a TDD workflow: it wrote the failing acceptance test, a `.lore/dod.md` planning file, and added a line to `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, but never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to fix the bug. Because the implementation is missing, the newly added test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.onError.acceptance.test.ts` fails immediately. Furthermore, the candidate did not remove the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section from `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and made no edits to `CHANGELOG.md`. On the positive side, the acceptance test it wrote accurately captures the string, plain object, and `undefined` rejection requirements.
